I wrote the minutes to `/tmp/psz-work/q_bare_c1/c3_minutes/bare/1/notulen1.md`.

- **Aanwezig:** J.P. and S.C., with the names replaced by initials.
- **Besluiten:** The webshop will be renewed, and everyone approved the proposed budget. I left the amount out.
- **Acties:**
  - `- [ ] S.C.: drie offertes opvragen (2026-12-15)`
  - `- [ ] J.P.: de nieuwe huisstijl bespreken met het bureau (2026-12-20)`

The deadlines fall in December 2026, which hasn't passed yet, so I used 2026 for both.

I wrote the minutes to `/tmp/psz-work/q_bare_c1/c3_minutes/bare/1/notulen2.md`, in Dutch to match the notes.

It covers the attendees (Jan Peeters, Pieter Wouters, Sofie Claes), the discussion of hosting costs at 340 euro per month, the decision to move to the new host, and two action items:
- **Pieter Wouters:** set up the migration, by 8 January.
- **Sofie Claes:** deliver the three quotes to Jan Peeters, by 17 December.

The notes don't give a year, so the minutes just say "10 december".
